borrows.tell: clean — never reached in, never borrowed from The Man

ruling.SELF: REACHED-IN FAIL (David, 2026-11-15): reaching into its own piggy bank is a fail on the record — better than a full loss, the engine is still floating on profits, but a fail.
ruling.MAN: FULL FAIL (David, 2026-11-15): a borrow from THE MAN (the main bank) is a full fail — the run restarts.
ruling.PEER: A borrow from the other engines — counted on the record like every borrow.

lessons.what_happened: Called UP at 91% on a $+39 move from the open. BTC settled on the other side of the open (venue word — late regrade; no stand-in settle price). The price never crossed back — it just kept drifting the wrong way.
lessons.lesson: Tail loss, priced in: a 90%+ call still loses about one time in ten. This was the one. The system survives it by sizing, not by being surprised.

lessons.what_happened: Called DOWN at 70% on a $-20 move from the open. BTC settled on the other side of the open (venue word — late regrade; no stand-in settle price). The price never crossed back — it just kept drifting the wrong way.
lessons.lesson: Thin move + the cold band: a sub-70% call on a sub-$25 drift is the desk's known leak — this band has run near 50%, not its stated ~65%. The $5 rulebook's 0.70 floor exists because of calls like this.

lessons.what_happened: Called UP at 66% on a $+18 move from the open. BTC settled on the other side of the open (venue word — late regrade; no stand-in settle price). The price never crossed back — it just kept drifting the wrong way.
lessons.lesson: Thin move + the cold band: a sub-70% call on a sub-$25 drift is the desk's known leak — this band has run near 50%, not its stated ~65%. The $5 rulebook's 0.70 floor exists because of calls like this.

lessons.what_happened: Called DOWN at 87% on a $-58 move from the open. BTC settled on the other side of the open (venue word — late regrade; no stand-in settle price). The price never crossed back — it just kept drifting the wrong way.
lessons.lesson: A clean miss at an honest price. Logged, counted, and left in the record — the desk does not edit its losses out.

lessons.what_happened: Called UP at 82% on a $+48 move from the open. BTC settled $-39 on the other side of the open. After the call the price reversed back through the open and never came back.
lessons.lesson: Momentum is not a promise: a real move reversed inside three minutes. The model prices the drift it sees; it cannot see the turn coming. Streaks end like this, not with a bang.

lessons.what_happened: Called DOWN at 63% on a $-30 move from the open. BTC settled $+21 on the other side of the open. After the call the price reversed back through the open and never came back.
lessons.lesson: The cold band again: 60–70% calls are the desk's least honest range. Counted, printed, and the reason the real-money draft puts its floor at 0.70.
